text: The CAREC Disaster Risk Transfer Facility (CAREC DRTF) is a regional initiative under the CAREC Program, supported by the Asian Development Bank (ADB), aimed at providing a comprehensive disaster risk financing solution for member countries, including Pakistan. It focuses on pooling and coordinating sovereign disaster risk financing needs, utilizing common risk analytics through the Disaster Risk Modelling Interface (DRMI), and structuring risk transfer solutions such as reinsurance and capital-market instruments like the ADB-sponsored Disaster Relief Bond (DRB). The facility also offers ancillary services such as capacity building, data governance, and advisory support.
